<reason>B won a close, high-quality debate by making last-word accountability and narrative selection the decisive clash. A was sharp on political incentives and the child who cannot vote, but never showed how a single textbook can transmit a non-selective “record.” B’s appointment dilemma and “first sentence” pressure boxed in A’s insulation design, and B honestly met the late-correction point: no system unteaches a lie, while insulation severs firing for the story itself and can slow reversal.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>B’s R2 (B4.4) turning A’s line that “the panel decides what evidence students must see” into confirmation that review selects the civic narrative, not merely fact-checks a waiting record.</best_rebuttal>
